elements.element: Customer is not subject to any employee non-solicitation restriction.
elements.evidence: The clause expressly binds both parties: “neither party will solicit any person employed by the other party.”

elements.element: The employee non-solicitation restriction is mutual.
elements.evidence: The restriction applies symmetrically through “neither party” and protects employees of “the other party.”

elements.element: Covered personnel are limited to personnel directly involved in the services.
elements.evidence: The clause is limited to an employee “who was directly involved in the performance of this Agreement,” which substantively limits coverage to personnel directly involved in the contracted performance.

elements.element: The post-involvement non-solicitation period is limited to 12 months.
elements.evidence: The stated tail is “the twelve (12) month period” following the specified endpoint.

elements.element: The 12-month period runs from the end of each covered person’s involvement in the services.
elements.evidence: The clause measures the 12-month period from “the expiration or termination of this Agreement,” not from the end of the particular employee’s involvement. An employee whose involvement ends earlier may therefore remain covered for substantially longer than 12 months after that involvement ends.

elements.element: General advertisements are excluded from solicitation.
elements.evidence: The definition states that solicitation “shall not mean generally advertising job openings” and also excludes follow-up with individuals responding to such advertisements.

elements.element: Unsolicited approaches by personnel are excluded from solicitation.
elements.evidence: The definition excludes follow-up with individuals “who voluntarily initiate employment inquiries.”

elements.element: The clause does not prohibit hiring personnel independently of prohibited solicitation.
elements.evidence: The operative restriction prohibits only solicitation to leave employment; it contains no independent prohibition on hiring or employing a person who approaches voluntarily or responds to a general advertisement.

result.reason: The redline does not achieve the preferred position because Customer remains bound. It largely tracks the fallback by making the restriction mutual, narrowing the covered employee population, using a 12-month stated tail, preserving the required carve-outs, and avoiding a no-hire restriction. However, the tail is triggered by expiration or termination of the Agreement rather than by the end of each employee’s involvement, so the fallback is not fully satisfied. The changes are confined to the non-solicitation provision and do not disturb unrelated commercial terms, but the incorrect duration trigger and the use of “was directly involved” reduce drafting precision.
